experiment: fixed A0-A6 feasibility coverage on train and validation voyages

metric_aggregation.best_fixed_action: maximum mean_fixed_reward_per_step among completed actions; exact ties select the smallest action_id and are also listed
metric_aggregation.action_state_and_hydrogen_means: unweighted arithmetic mean across successful voyages
metric_aggregation.pooled_mean_reward_per_step: sum of completed-voyage rewards divided by sum of their steps
metric_aggregation.battery_net_energy_sign: positive is net discharge; negative is net charge
metric_aggregation.failed_action_metrics: full-voyage success metrics are null after first failure

best_action_interpretation.research_scope: Different best fixed actions under the common reward support inter-voyage weight dependence, but alone do not prove that within-voyage DQN switching is necessary.

action_space_coverage.conclusion: Some train/validation voyages have no successful fixed A0-A6 action; further diagnosis is required before attributing this to weight range versus the N=6 MPC mechanism.
